primary_reference.name: Utilitarian
selected_because: Fits high-frequency operations and dense catalog/discovery work
Supports trust, clarity, keyboard use, and status visibility
component_implications: tables, forms, status badges, explicit actions
accessibility_risks: Avoid excessive density; preserve readable line height and responsive stacking

secondary_references.name: Bento Grid Tech Minimalist
selected_because: Adds modular grouping for overview and status panels without changing utility-first behavior

rejected_references.name: Glassmorphism
rejected_references.reason: Potential contrast and status legibility issues for operational screens

rejected_references.name: Aurora
rejected_references.reason: Atmospheric treatment would compete with dense workflows
